brief:
Germany has moved to dismiss a lawsuit accusing it of supporting genocide in Gaza, the Ma'an news agency reported. The case challenges Berlin's military and financial assistance to Israel during the conflict in the territory.

The legal action represents an effort by Palestinians and their supporters to hold Germany accountable for its backing of Israeli operations. The lawsuit centers on allegations that Germany's provision of weapons and economic support constitutes complicity in acts that plaintiffs characterize as genocidal.

Germany's dismissal request marks an early procedural stage in litigation. The motion comes as international courts and advocacy groups examine the legal responsibilities of nations that supply military aid to countries engaged in active warfare.
title: Germany seeks dismissal of genocide-support lawsuit over Gaza
